sentences.en: There were hundreds of people milling about in the streets.
A large crowd was soon milling around the accident scene.
sentences.zh: 很快就有许多人聚集在事故现场附近。

sentences.en: Thousands of people were milling around in the square.
sentences.zh: 广场上有很多人走来走去。
